answer: Unrepeatable Task Quota. Each identity must solve a freshly generated, single-use spatial puzzle whose solution seeds a ledger entry; the puzzle references a physical site (a terrace, a loading bay) observed via a signed sensor feed, so answers cannot be copied or precomputed. A solved puzzle unlocks one vault credit. Attacker cost: one sensor-authenticated observation plus compute per identity per epoch, and duplicate solutions are rejected by the timber-marked hash chain, so bulk registration scales linearly in real-world sensing work rather than in cheap key generation.
